name: 85 - API - Process Message Delivery Status - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT NULLIF($1::BIGINT,0) message_id,NULLIF($2::TEXT,'') provider_message_id,
         $3::TEXT channel,$4::TEXT event_type,$5::TIMESTAMPTZ event_at,
         NULLIF($6::TEXT,'') error_code,NULLIF($7::TEXT,'') error_message,
         $8::JSONB raw_event
),
m AS (
  SELECT om.*
  FROM outbound_messages om,r
  WHERE (r.message_id IS NOT NULL AND om.id=r.message_id)
     OR (r.provider_message_id IS NOT NULL AND om.provider_message_id=r.provider_message_id)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.message_id IS NOT NULL AND om.id=r.message_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
  LIMIT 1
),
event AS (
  INSERT INTO communication_delivery_events(
    outbound_message_id,provider_message_id,channel,event_type,event_at,
    error_code,error_message,raw_event
  )
  SELECT m.id,COALESCE(r.provider_message_id,m.provider_message_id),r.channel,
         r.event_type,r.event_at,r.error_code,r.error_message,r.raw_event
  FROM m,r
  RETURNING *
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE outbound_messages om
  SET status=CASE r.event_type
        WHEN 'accepted' THEN 'accepted'
        WHEN 'sent' THEN 'sent'
        WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'delivered'
        WHEN 'read' THEN 'read'
        WHEN 'failed' THEN 'failed'
        WHEN 'undeliverable' THEN 'failed'
        WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'failed'
        ELSE om.status END,
      provider_message_id=COALESCE(r.provider_message_id,om.provider_message_id),
      accepted_at=CASE WHEN r.event_type='accepted' THEN r.event_at ELSE om.accepted_at END,
      sent_at=CASE WHEN r.event_type='sent' THEN r.event_at ELSE om.sent_at END,
      delivered_at=CASE WHEN r.event_type='delivered' THEN r.event_at ELSE om.delivered_at END,
      read_at=CASE WHEN r.event_type='read' THEN r.event_at ELSE om.read_at END,
      failed_at=CASE WHEN r.event_type IN ('failed','undeliverable','rejected') THEN r.event_at ELSE om.failed_at END,
      last_error_code=CASE WHEN r.event_type IN ('failed','undeliverable','rejected') THEN r.error_code ELSE om.last_error_code END,
      last_error_message=CASE WHEN r.event_type IN ('failed','undeliverable','rejected') THEN r.error_message ELSE om.last_error_message END,
      next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN r.event_type IN ('failed','undeliverable','rejected') THEN NOW()+INTERVAL '15 minutes' ELSE om.next_attempt_at END,
      updated_at=NOW()
  FROM r,m
  WHERE om.id=m.id
  RETURNING om.*
)
SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m) success,
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m) THEN 'outbound_message_not_found'
       ELSE 'delivery_status_processed' END result,
  (SELECT id FROM updated) outbound_message_id,
  (SELECT status FROM updated) message_status,
  (SELECT id FROM event) delivery_event_id,
  (SELECT provider_message_id FROM updated) provider_message_id;

parameters.content:
## Callback وضعیت پیام

Provider یا Adapter این Webhook را فراخوانی می‌کند.

وضعیت‌های accepted، sent، delivered، read و failed ثبت می‌شوند.
